issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: red_wall_banner, cauldron.
460 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Adds lanterns on chains, barrels and a ram frame, still sparse outside.
notes.purpose: The battering ram doesn't read as one: Catapult is almost invisible: hidden under the low roof in every iso, and from the front only a pale block mass shows behind the dark beam at (3..7,4,1).
notes.scale: Ram is 2 blocks of dark oak log (0,1,9..10) hung from a spruce beam, pushed against the west wall outside the eave; it reads as a stick on the wall, not a ram in a frame.
notes.levels: L3 is barely different from L2 in iso: a barrel stack at the front corner and a thin frame on the back side.

visual.summary: L2 plus a small battering ram frame on the west side, lanterns on chains and stacked barrels; the ram is too small and tucked away to read.
problems: Battering ram at x0 z8..11 is too short (2-block ram) and squeezed against the wall outside the eave; make it a proper 4-5 block ram with a head, in its own A-frame shed or out front, so L3 reads at a glance.
Floating blocks: oak slabs at (6,2,2) and (7,2,2) have nothing under them (y1 is air there); add the bench legs or remove them.
Back gable has a 1-block hole at (5,5,11) (row 'VTT.TTW'); fill it or make it a clear vent (trapdoor/fence).
Front gable is completely open (y5..6 at z1); for a shed that is acceptable, but give it barge boards or a partial infill so it looks finished.
Lean-to roof (spruce slabs at y3, x9..12 z2..10) is dead flat and reads as a deck; slope it with stairs down to x12.
Reachability: fine; unreached places are roof slopes, the flat lean-to roof and catapult/bench tops, no room or floor is cut off.
